name: Best Western Rewards

apr.notes: 25.99% to 29.99% variable APR based on Prime Rate. Minimum interest charge $1.50. Balance Transfer Fee: 4% or $5 min. Cash Advance Fee: 5% or $10 min. Accurate as of 12/31/2025.

credit_required.notes: Not specified by the issuer. Mercury Financial focuses on broader accessibility. Prequalification available without hard pull. Bonus offer varies by prequalification.

base_rate.description: 2 points per $1 on all other (non-Best Western) purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: BWR points never expire. Redeem for free and discounted stays at 4,300+ BWH Hotels properties across 18 brands in 100+ countries, gift cards, and charitable donations. Redemptions start at 5,000 points. Combined with BWR membership (10 points/$1 on stays), cardholders earn 14 points/$1 on Best Western stays.

signup_bonus.description: Bonus points offer of 10,000 to 40,000 points with qualifying spend. Exact bonus and minimum spend vary based on prequalification. Pay with Points value up to $200.

benefits.title: 10,000 Anniversary Bonus Points
benefits.description: Earn 10,000 bonus points by spending $5,000 during each cardmember year.

benefits.title: Automatic Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Best Western Rewards Gold Elite status: 10% bonus points per stay, no blackout dates, 500 bonus points at check-in. Normally requires 5 nights per year.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: When you pay your monthly wireless bill with your card, your cell phone is protected for the next calendar month.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $300 when stuck for more than 12 hours when booking travel with card.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation/Interruption Reimbursement
benefits.description: Covered for non-refundable fare up to $2,000 if trip is interrupted or cancelled.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic Best Western Rewards Gold Elite status (10% bonus points per stay, no blackout dates, 500 bonus points at check-in)
other: Trip delay reimbursement up to $300 (12+ hour delay)

notes: Issuer changed from FNBO to First Bank & Trust, Brookings, SD (managed by Mercury Financial) in Aug 2024. FNBO no longer issues this card. The bestwestern.com page is the only official product/application page. Visa Signature. $0 annual fee.
